retraction.reason: Re-read on 24 September under A14(6) against the rule that replaced M44b's. A record earns its place by carrying at least one honest edge to anything already in the atlas, and nobody writes an edge in order to keep a record. The corpus is now 859 active events across all five lanes, where M44b judged this one against the Portuguese core alone. The treaty of 1967 still has one neighbour available here, the Charter, on the ground that a United Nations committee negotiated it, and that edge would look the same drawn on any other multilateral treaty. The world corpus has added no space record for it to reach. It stays retracted under the new rule.

title: Outer Space Treaty
summary: Wikidata item Q256608, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty that forms the basis of international space law". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: The Wikidata import wrote this lane from the event's own point. The event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
